Aigami (, Aigami), real name Diva (ディーヴァ, Dīva), is the main antagonist in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions. He is described as a mysterious youth who holds the keys to the movie's story.

page.overview:
Who is Aigami?

Aigami is a Legendary Duelist in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links. This is a video game depiction of Aigami, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions film.

He is exclusive to the special event, Raid Duel - Dimensional Disaster: Buster Gundil the Cubic Behemoth, only being able to be dueled during the event. He was made unlockable in Raid Duel - Dimensional Disaster: Indiora Doom Volt the Cubic Emperor.

Black Gate Keys are required to Duel Aigami at the Gate.

Skill: No Match for the Plana (At the beginning of your turn, if your LP are 4000 or lower, play 1 "Buster Gundil the Cubic Behemoth" from outside of your Deck to your field and make its ATK 3000. At the beginning of your Battle Phase, if your LP are 2000 or lower, increase the ATK of all monsters on your field by 500. This Skill can only be applied once per Duel.)
